figurative_meaning_en: A large number of people in each group
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই দলে ভারী লোকজনের কারণে সবাই ভয় পায়।
তাদের দলে ভারী হওয়ায় তারা সহজেই জিতে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The team is heavy with people, so everyone is intimidated.
They won easily because their group was heavy in numbers.
note: Refers to numerical strength in groups, common in Bengali social contexts.
